label: final copy step of short (L=3/4) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original inputs or the delimiter), almost entirely on the final output step (to_go==0: 93% of activation mass; to_go==1 holds most of the rest). Strongly gated by sequence length: at L=3 it fires on the last step of essentially every sequence (precision 0.999) and carries 54% of mass, including all the top activations (e.g. q b 3 <DEL> q [b]); at L=4 it fires on ~40% of final steps, preferring inputs b,v,p,k,m,n,a,f,u,j; for L>=5 it is weak and sparse (~10% of mass, mostly last or second-to-last step). Magnitude is largest at L=3 and when first token is q. Does not fire on early copy steps or on any original-phase step. Recall is incomplete because of scattered weak activations in longer sequences.
